hint.property.justify-content: You need justify-content — it controls how heroes align on the main axis.
hint.property.align-items: You need align-items — it aligns heroes on the cross axis.
hint.property.flex-direction: You need flex-direction — it sets whether heroes flow in a row or column.
hint.property.flex-wrap: You need flex-wrap — it controls whether heroes wrap onto new lines.
hint.property.align-self: You need align-self — it aligns just this one hero independently.
hint.property.order: You need order — it changes the visual order of a hero.
hint.declaration.order-last: Try: order: -1; (to move it to the start)
hint.property.align-content: You need align-content — it aligns wrapped rows of heroes.
hint.property.grid-template-columns: You need grid-template-columns — it defines the grid columns.
hint.property.grid-column: You need grid-column — it sets how many columns a hero spans.
hint.property.gap: You need gap — the space between heroes in the grid.
hint.property.justify-items: You need justify-items — it centers heroes inside their cells.
level.flexbox.01-01.title: Center the Hero
level.flexbox.01-01.instruction: Spider-Man needs to reach the center of the web. Use justify-content to center him horizontally.
level.flexbox.01-02.title: Escape Right
level.flexbox.01-02.instruction: Iron Man must fly to the right side. Use justify-content: flex-end.
level.flexbox.01-03.title: Team Patrol
level.flexbox.01-03.instruction: Three heroes must spread across the space. Use justify-content: space-between.
level.flexbox.01-04.title: Vertical Flight
level.flexbox.01-04.instruction: Captain America needs to be centered vertically. Use align-items: center.
level.flexbox.01-05.title: Perfect Center
level.flexbox.01-05.instruction: The hero must be exactly in the center. Use both justify-content and align-items.
level.flexbox.01-06.title: Column Formation
level.flexbox.01-06.instruction: Heroes must fly in a column. Use flex-direction: column.
level.flexbox.01-07.title: Too Many Heroes
level.flexbox.01-07.instruction: Too many heroes for one row. Use flex-wrap: wrap so they continue on the next line.
level.flexbox.01-08.title: The Straggler
level.flexbox.01-08.instruction: The last hero must drop to the bottom. Use align-self: flex-end on that hero only.
level.flexbox.01-09.title: Order Change
level.flexbox.01-09.instruction: The red hero must appear first. Use order: -1 to move it to the start.
level.flexbox.01-10.title: Row Spacing
level.flexbox.01-10.instruction: Heroes are in two rows. Use align-content: space-between to separate them.
level.grid.02-01.title: Three Columns
level.grid.02-01.instruction: Create three equal columns for the heroes using grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr).
level.grid.02-02.title: Important Hero
level.grid.02-02.instruction: The first hero needs more space — make it span two columns using grid-column: span 2.
level.grid.02-03.title: Hero Spacing
level.grid.02-03.instruction: Add 16px of space between all heroes using the gap property.
level.grid.02-04.title: Centered Heroes
level.grid.02-04.instruction: Center all heroes inside their cells using justify-items: center.
